name: Mir
source:
Voiced by: Mary Elizabeth McGlynn (English)

[spoiler]Mir is a Reyvateil created by humans to have no emotions, as her creators believed that this would result in a stronger Reyvateil. However, she developed emotions over time, which displeased her creators.

Because of her treatment as a tool by humans, she loathed them, and planned to exterminate them to create a world only for Reyvateils. Even after she was sealed by Shurelia and Tastiella, she retained her hatred for humans.

[From [url=http://artonelico.wikia.com/wiki/Mir#Involvement_in_Ar_tonelico_1]Ar Tonelico Wiki[/url] and [url=http://artonelico.isisview.org/wiki/index.php/Settei_book_translations/Characters_section#Mir]A Reyvateil's Memory Wiki[/url]][/spoiler]
